title: API Activity event (paging-system page dispatch + responder acknowledgement)
summary: OCSF API Activity events the on_call_rotation playbook reads to observe page dispatch along the bound escalation chain and the first responder acknowledgement returned by the operator's paging system. The same class carries handoff-brief delivery confirmation events emitted by the bound delivery channel (paging-system DM, chat thread, email gateway) so the delivery-SLA KPI can resolve deliver-time independently of compose-time.
